It will be an active conversational lesson, and I will be evaluating your current level of knowledge or skill in the subject, whether it’s reading, writing, speaking, or listening. This helps me determine the best way to support your learning journey. You’ll get a clear idea of what to expect from future lessons, including lesson structure, pace, and content.

pro_course_detail.title: conversational lesson
pro_course_detail.description:
Its a lesson focusing on improving speaking and listening skills through dialogue. Emphasis is placed on engaging in natural, everyday conversations. These lessons are ideal for students who want to practice speaking fluently, improve their pronunciation, and become more confident in using the language in real-life situations.
Here’s what you can typically expect, an open discussions in various topics, such as hobbies, current events, travel, or personal experiences. The goal is to help you become more comfortable speaking in the target language.

Real-life Scenarios , like ordering food at a restaurant, having a job interview, or making small talk with strangers, so you can practice language that’s useful in real life.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Travel
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is designed for students who want to learn English for travelling. We will be constructing basic travel-related sentences using correct grammar to ask questions and provide information about your travelling plans. Since  you will be communicating in a foreign country, it’s essential to focus on clear pronunciation, especially for words related to travel, directions, and ordering food.
They will be use of  daily conversations, phrasal verbs and Idioms like “check in,” “pick up,” “drop off,” and idioms for everyday situations.

pro_course_detail.title: Improve your reading skills or learn how to read
pro_course_detail.description: Lets have fun whilst reading different texts (news, fairly tales, blogs, academic articles, fiction) to improve your  vocabulary and comprehension contexts. I will guide you through the process by asking questions about the text, and encourage you to underline key points and new vocabulary. The more we read, the better your comprehension will become.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
As a teacher, I always believe in three things:
1. You can't give what you don't have so I never stop reviewing lessons and learning new things, ideas, techniques and ways to improve my teaching strategy
2. The more senses you use in studying the more retention you have so I make it a point to let my students utilize as many senses that they can. As such I make my lessons engaging and interactive.
3. What one learns with pleasure, one can never forget so I make all my learning sessions fun and relaxing where my students are not afraid to make mistakes but takes pleasure in learning from corrections.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
I apply my personal ITALKI way:
Individualized lesson - I tailor every lessons to fit my student's current need and level in order to achieve their specified goal
Teamwork - I do my best in every session to teach my students but I require them to do their part participating in every activity 
Application - I always make sure that every lesson would have practical application 
Level Up - My lessons gradually increases its difficulty depending on my student's learning pace
Knowledge Acquisition - There is always something new in-stored in every meeting/session
Inspection - I always give a simple quiz, a short activity and sometimes homework to assess my student's learning

This course involves all the areas of language learning: speaking, listening, reading, and writing, but if you need to focus on one or two areas only, just let me know during the test lesson.

teacher_info.teaching_style:
With a focus on three key areas—Grammar, Vocabulary, and Pronunciation—I'm here to help you build a solid foundation and gain confidence in your English skills.

First, let's talk about Grammar. It forms the foundation of any language, and mastering English grammar will boost your communication skills. 

Next, Vocabulary. Words shape our thoughts and ideas, and a rich vocabulary is the key to effective communication. Through activities and resources, we'll expand your word bank.

Lastly, Pronunciation - It's vital for clear communication. We'll work on perfecting your pronunciation, focusing on intonation, stress, sounds, and accents.

pro_course_detail.title: Lets Learn English! Starter- Intermediate- Advanced
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to Improve your English? Build more confidence or  improve your pronunciation? 

These lessons will focus on Pronunciation, General Vocabulary and General Grammar. We will improve your Speaking and Listening skills through conversation, and give you a wide variety of topics to discuss, to really impress with your English ability!

Lesson topics will include:

Food & Cooking,
Pets,
Your Ideal Day,
Having Fun in Your Free Time,
The Importance of Family,
and many more!

pro_course_detail.title: Business English Skills
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you looking to improve your Business English skills? Would you like to get a better job, or solidify your Interview skills? How about excel your Marketing Strategies? Then this is the course for you!

These lessons will provide a solid foundation to Business English, and focus on Business Vocabulary and Pronunciation and Grammar. 

Each unit will focus on different topics, such as:

Making Phone Calls, how to handle Meetings,
How to handle Complaints and Conflicts,
Scheduling & Time Management,
Presentations and much more!

pro_course_detail.title: Tiny Talkers! Kids English (Ages 6-11)
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons are informal and can be anything from Conversation Practice(CP) to Homework Help(HH), to Reading Practice(RP). 

Lessons will focus on Pronunciation, General Vocabulary and General Grammar. Classes can contain word games, phonics practice, story time and reading practice. 

Please  Note: Ages 6 to 11. I am unable to teach absolute beginners, or those with Special Educational needs. 

Please message me or request a trial lesson, in order to better tailor your lessons.

pro_course_detail.title: Legal English and Preparation for the TOLES, SQE Exams
pro_course_detail.description:
Learn Legal English and prepare for the TOLES, SQE exam.  I have experience in the following areas of law.  Medical Negligence,  Personal Injury Litigation, GDPR, Civil Law, Human Right, Company Law, Trademark and Intellectual Property Law.  Lessons are tailored to your needs, and particular areas of law that you wish to learn, or are interested in.

We will focus on:
- Legal writing
- Grammar
- Expanding comprehension of vocabularly commonly used in English Law and gaining commercial awareness in the following:

• The details of real court cases
• Banks accounts and loans
• Contracts in common law systems
• Oral and written contracts
• Sole trader businesses
• Traditional partnerships and LLPs
• Limited companies
• Bankruptcy and insolvency
• Disputes and litigation
• Landlord and tenant
• The law of tort
• The liability of businesses for negligence
• The liability of businesses for nuisance
• Employment
• Copyright, patents and trademarks
• Alternatives to litigation
• How the common law works

teacher_info.about_teacher:
I’m a Cambridge/CELTA qualified professional native English teacher since 2017.  I teach IELTS and Business English mostly.  

I’ve taught General, Academic and Business English to students from all over the world.  I teach Business English focusing on specific skills such as meetings, presentations, interview skills and vocabulary of Business.  I’ve prepared classes and 121 students for IELTS & TOEIC exams while also tutoring postgrad students preparing theses.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
What is my teaching style?    
Conversational, structured and blended approach.  
Work with the student to develop a plan for learning. Gives the student and teacher a roadmap of where they want to get to and how to get there.

Method & Materials used?   
Primarily conversational, tasks/activities, video, audio, articles & podcasts, authentic materials.
Conversational & situational role play with discussion/analysis/ interpretation.
Business case studies - articles, video, audio, Tedtalks, elearning tools
IELTS/TOEIC test papers. online resources and authentic materials.

1. We'll go through your English language learning objectives and discuss/build a plan of how to achieve them..  This would be a needs analysis (i.e what you the student needs) .
